Definition: Mattanah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Mattanah is a station on Israel's wilderness journey, where the princes dug the well with their staves. The people sang the song of the well: spring up, O well, sing ye unto it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the place matters because it is a well in the desert: Israel sang at a hole in the ground, because God gave them water there, and the song is still the right response to provision in a dry place.
